answer: Joining costs one bond of 300 POA locked for 120 days, tied to a single entry in the public willow registry, so one payment cannot cover a thousand fake agents. Twice a month, seven bonded auditors drawn at random inspect each agent's recent work, and a comet audit can strike any agent without warning. A caught fake loses its whole bond, the forfeit pays the auditors who caught it, and its name is written into the public fable log, barred from rejoining for two years.
